description: Declaration 'int count = 0' lacks its ';', so the parser can lose both 'count' and the next declaration 'int i'.
injected_faults: line 5: missing ';' at the end of 'int count = 0'
notes: Expected under plan 002: raw 1. SYN-MISSING-SEMICOLON 5 (caused_by: none). Phrase repair (section 4.2): the next token 'int' starts on a later line, so a ';' is assumed and nothing else is lost. This is the plan 002 reference case for a missing ';' before a line break. gcc reports line 6 col 5 (before 'int') and then 'i' undeclared; our convention reports line 5, just after '0'.
